page.overview:
What is Dark Cave?

The Dark Cave is a location introduced in Generation II.

The Dark Cave is a cave in Johto that neighbors three routes, each allowing access to a different part of the cave. The first entrance is located on Route 31, and it provides access to the southwest of the southern area. The second entrance is located south of Blackthorn City, and it allows the player to explore the northern area. The last entrance is located on Route 46, and it provides access to the southeast of the southern area. All three areas are on the same floor.

The location is named for its lack of visibility, requiring the player to use TM70 (Flash) to see their surroundings. Additionally, the player is also required to use HM04 (Strength) and HM06 (Rock Smash) to progress. Another feature of the Dark Cave is that it is the only area in Johto where the player can encounter wild Wobbuffets.

A Dunsparce swarm can sometimes occur in the Dark Cave. If the player has the Pokégear number of Hiker Anthony registered, he calls them if the swarm occurs.
